review_kind: Fresh local supplemental engineering source-only review of disabled-plan preparer

findings.title: Generated plans omit mandatory remote-scorer plan_path
findings.evidence: prepare() calculates an absolute plan_path and places it only in command[-1]. The emitted plan dict has no plan_path key. Existing prepare_request() directly indexes plan["plan_path"] at line134 and again at line136.
findings.reproduction: Used the existing synthetic fixture and actual prepare(), enabled a deep-copied full plan with an in-memory review/canonical binding, then called actual remote.prepare_request with only local JSON reads and review hashing mocked in memory. authenticate() and real helper/scorer source hash checks passed; line134 raised KeyError('plan_path'). No SSH, scorer, archive or reconstruction was invoked. Both modes in all four host/variant fixture combinations omit the key.
findings.impact: Current generated full plan cannot be passed unchanged through the supplied remote CPU scoring wrapper. Adding the field later changes the canonical plan binding and requires a new exact plan review.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Include plan_path=plan_path in each emitted plan before computing binding; add a focused handoff test against prepare_request that verifies equality with command[-1] and the exact request plan path. Do not modify consumer admission checks.
findings.test_gap: The current 19 tests never call the remote consumer and therefore pass despite the schema mismatch.
